answer: Locks are written down in sonnet, expire in echo, and falcon lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 198 aliases as a result needs 189 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Scaling to 414 identities multiplies that fee by 744 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
